Description: {{TAG|VDW_S8}} sets the scaling <math>s_{8}</math> of the dipole-quadrupole dispersion of the DFT-D3 and [[DFT-D4]] methods.
----
{{TAG|VDW_S8}} allows to set the scaling <math>s_{8}</math> of the dipole-quadrupole dispersion of the DFT-D3 and [[DFT-D4]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=13) methods. {{TAG|VDW_S8}} can be used for both implementations of DFT-D3: [[DFT-D3]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=11 or 12) and [[simple-DFT-D3]] ({{TAG|IVDW}}=15).
